newsitem.title: UK: Axa kept at hold by Salomon Brothers.
newsitem.headline: Axa kept at hold by Salomon Brothers.

text.p: Stockbroker Salomon Brothers said on Monday it was maintaining its "hold" rating on French insurance market leader Axa ahead of the company's 1996 results due on March 26.
In the wake of Axa's recent merger with UAP, Salomon urged "caution amid the euphoria" in a research note.
"We expect 1996 final results to show robust operational earnings for both companies, particularly Axa...However, Axa will make large and visible restatements to UAP's balance sheet."
"We still question whether the UAP acquisition is the best use of Axa's capital and management situation," Salomon said.

However, Axa and UAP should both show robust operating earnings for 1996 and Salomon expects savings of at least 1.2 billion francs from the merger by 1999, compared with Axa's initial aim of one billion francs.
Salomon has raised its target price for Axa shares to 390 francs. The shares are currently trading around 372.
